description: Internal header for the 'refs' module, defining data structures, macros, and function prototypes for reference management in a version control system, including reference updates, validation, and iteration.

methods.name: get_files_ref_lock_timeout_ms
methods.description: Returns the timeout in milliseconds for retrying to acquire a loose reference lock.

methods.name: refname_is_safe
methods.description: Checks if a reference name is minimally safe for deletion without causing damage.

methods.name: ref_resolves_to_object
methods.description: Helper to verify if a refname with a given oid and flags can be resolved in the database.

methods.name: refs_read_raw_ref
methods.description: Reads raw reference data from a ref store.

methods.name: parse_loose_ref_contents
methods.description: Parses the contents of a loose ref file.

methods.name: base_ref_store_init
methods.description: Initializes the base part of a ref_store and adds it to the collection.

methods.name: maybe_debug_wrap_ref_store
methods.description: Wraps a ref_store with debugging support if needed.

methods.name: ref_update_original_update_refname
methods.description: Returns the original refname requested for an update.

methods.name: ref_update_has_null_new_value
methods.description: Checks if the new value in a ref_update is null.

methods.name: ref_update_check_old_target
methods.description: Verifies if the old_target in a ref_update matches the current referent.

methods.name: ref_update_expects_existing_old_ref
methods.description: Checks if a ref_update expects the reference to exist.

methods.name: refs_verify_refnames_available
methods.description: Verifies that multiple refnames are available for update, considering extras and skip lists.
